title: Bounce flash
summary: Soft, natural light indoors from a ceiling or wall.

blocks.note: Higher ISO lets the flash reach further when bounced.

steps: Mount the flash and switch it on.
Tilt the head toward a white ceiling or wall, not straight at the subject.
Use Av or M and a moderate aperture.
Shoot and check. Too dark? Raise ISO, open the aperture or bounce off a closer surface.

items: Coloured walls tint the light. White or grey is safest.
High ceilings swallow light. Bounce off a nearby wall instead.
Bounce behind you for very soft, wide light.

steps: Load **4 AA** batteries of the same type. Slide the foot all the way into the R10's hot shoe and tighten the **locking collar**. The 420EX fits the R10 directly.
Set the **wireless selector to OFF** and switch it on. The pilot lamp lights when it's ready.
Camera in **Av or M**. The flash runs E-TTL automatically.
Hold the bounce release button and tilt the head: **up 60°, 75° or 90°**, **left up to 180°**, **right up to 90°**. The zoom jumps to 50 mm by itself.
Shoot. The **green confirmation lamp** lights for about 3 s if there was enough light. No green: open the aperture, raise ISO or bounce off something closer.
Brighter or darker: set flash exposure compensation on the R10 in **Shooting 3 › Flash control** (±2 stops).
canon-speedlite-420ex.note: Recycling takes up to 7.5 s, so leave a moment between shots.
